levels.description:
14th October 1806
You are Frederick, Prince of Hohenlohe. You and your ally Duke of Brunswick command a grand Prussian army of 110000 men. Napoleon has driven deep into Germany and threatens Berlin. His Grand Armee has gathered and occupies the town of Jena with advanced guards near key terrain ahead of his main position. You must destroy the Grand Armee and take back Jena. Prussia has been humiliated too many times by Napoleon... Stop him before all honour is lost.

levels.description:
21st February - 18th December 1916
You are Field Marshal Erich Von Falkenhayn. Your mission is to take the Fortress city of Verdun by way of bleeding the French into submission. You have 750,000 men at your disposal against a French army of over 1,000,000 men. The field of battle has been turned to a quagmire and head on attacks are bogged down and met with torrential artillery shelling. The Entente is one victory away from crushing the Central Powers, restoring balance and peace to Europe again. You must win.
